name: The prince returns

date.label: The Burning Crusade · exact in-world date unknown

summary: After his defeat in Outland, Kael’thas returned to Silvermoon. He betrayed the people he had promised to lead and turned toward a new design: using the Sunwell to summon Kil’jaeden. Thus the fount became an immediate danger once more, and an inheritance the blood elves could not reclaim.
